categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Shenling Environmental Systems Co., Ltd. primarily operates in specialized air conditioning and temperature control equipment manufacturing. Its main business segments include data service industry environment solutions, industrial process environment solutions, special application environments, and public building and commercial air conditioning. The company offers integrated solutions encompassing R&D, manufacturing, marketing, implementation, and maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-efficiency evaporative cooling, liquid cooling systems, AIoT-based smart energy management, and digital energy environment solutions. It employs an ETO (Engineer-to-Order) manufacturing model with platform-based, standardized, modular, and structured product development to meet customized client needs. The company holds numerous patents, especially in liquid cooling technology, and emphasizes innovation in energy efficiency, environmental protection, and intelligent control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecom operators, internet giants (e.g., Huawei, Tencent, Alibaba, ByteDance), data center operators, industrial enterprises in power, chemical, metallurgy, automotive, new energy sectors, and public infrastructure such as airports, hospitals, and rail transit. The company serves industries requiring precise environmental control for data centers, industrial manufacturing, special applications like nuclear power and VOCs treatment, and commercial/public buildings.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant presence in Guangdong province and other major cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Wuhan, Xi'an, Jinan, and Tianjin. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Germany, and is actively expanding its overseas business in Southeast Asia, targeting countries like Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Thailand, especially in the AI computing center market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenling operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of specialized air conditioning and temperature control equipment. It provides end-to-end solutions including product sales, system integration, and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or basic component manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-efficiency, energy-saving, and digitalized air conditioning technologies, including liquid cooling, phase change cooling, and heat storage systems. It focuses on innovation in AIoT, digital energy management, and industry-specific customized solutions. Future R&D directions include expanding liquid cooling capabilities for AI and high-pressure fast charging industries, enhancing nuclear-grade equipment, and developing integrated energy storage thermal management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialized air conditioning equipment and integrated solutions, including digital energy and environmental management services. The company also earns income from engineering implementation, after-sales maintenance, and related service contracts. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with a focus on large-scale projects and customized solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Shenling is positioned as a leading domestic provider of specialized air conditioning and temperature control solutions with international-level technology in key sectors such as data centers, nuclear power, and industrial applications. Its strong patent portfolio, government-recognized innovation status, and extensive project experience provide competitive advantages in high-end and niche markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.02 billion, representing a 20.11% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 115.56 million, up 10.17%. The company has shown steady growth, particularly in the data service segment with a 75.4% revenue increase. Total assets reached RMB 5.36 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 2.53 billion, reflecting moderate scale and ongoing expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenling emphasizes high-efficiency, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly specialized air conditioning solutions tailored to complex and critical industry applications. Its products offer precise control of temperature, humidity, cleanliness, and airflow, with capabilities for extreme environments and specialized requirements such as anti-corrosion, explosion-proof, and seismic resistance. The company’s integrated digital and AIoT-enabled energy management solutions further differentiate it by providing comprehensive, intelligent, and sustainable environmental control.
